gloss: benefactor, person to whom one owes gratitude

definitions.gloss: benefactor, person to whom one is indebted
definitions.explanation: A person who has done something significant to help you; someone to whom you owe gratitude.

examples.english: He is the person who saved my life.
examples.notes: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧の{恩人|おんじん} = life-saver

examples.japanese: {恩人|おんじん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I will never forget my gratitude to my benefactor.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{恩人|おんじん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: That teacher is a benefactor to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧{恩人|おんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I will never forget the benefactor who helped me when I was in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}っていた→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧{恩人|おんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I send a New Year's card every year to the benefactor who took care of me when I was struggling during my studies abroad.

notes:
{恩人|おんじん} refers to someone who has done you a significant favor or helped you in an important way.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恩人|おんじん} (life-saver, someone who saved one's life)
- 〜⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恩人|おんじん} (benefactor to ~)
- {恩人|おんじん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恩返|おんがえ}し→恩返し：11063_ongaeshi⟧ (repaying one's benefactor)

RELATED CONCEPT:
- ⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧ (debt of gratitude, favor received)
- ⟦{恩返|おんがえ}し→恩返し：11063_ongaeshi⟧ (repaying a favor)
- ⟦{恩知|おんし}らず→恩知らず：15485_onshirazu⟧ (ingrate, ungrateful person)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The concept of ⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧ (debt of gratitude) is deeply embedded in Japanese culture
- One is expected to remember and repay kindnesses received
